svg.title: Where Iberian lynx live
svg.desc: A simplified map of Spain and Portugal. Iberian lynx live in Mediterranean scrubland, with the two original strongholds at Doñana in the south west and Sierra Morena to its north east, plus newer areas where they have spread. In 2002 fewer than 100 survived in two isolated patches of Spain, with none in Portugal. By 2025 there were 2,663, made up of 2,269 in Spain and 394 in Portugal.

text.font-family: Georgia, serif
-apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only in Spain and Portugal. Twenty years ago there were fewer than a hundred.
